channel.title: James Tuttiett - Thoughts
channel.description: Perspectives on AI transformation, consulting operating models and the future of work.

item.title: Workforce Supplier or Technical Consultancy?
item.description: Clients are no longer buying resource. They are buying architecture, AI delivery, and outcomes. The strategic question staffing and workforce businesses now need to answer.

item.title: Resetting the Workforce for an AI-Assisted Market
item.description: The workforce question is now inseparable from the strategy question. Resetting team shape, role design, and workforce value for an AI-assisted market.

item.title: "AI Is the Product" vs "AI Does the Work"
item.description: Most enterprise AI conversations confuse two very different things. Separating them is the fastest way to work out where the value is and who it reaches first.

item.title: Why We Went From Five Practices to Three
item.description: Practice structures usually describe what a firm can do. Clients do not buy that way. Build, Scale, Run is an attempt to organise around how they actually buy.

item.title: Building an AI Centre of Excellence From a Two-Week Course
item.description: In January the AI capability was one training course and a team of two. What it took to get to consultants deployed in client environments inside a year.

item.title: Why Most AI Transformations Fail Before They Start
item.description: Organisations are buying AI tools at scale, but adoption rates remain stubbornly low. The problem isn't the technology. It's the change model.

item.title: The Death of 'Bodies on Seats': Rethinking the Consulting Model
item.description: The traditional Time & Materials consulting model is under terminal pressure. AI is changing where value comes from, and most firms aren't ready for the conversation.

item.title: Selling in a Down Cycle: What the Numbers Actually Tell You
item.description: When the market contracts, most sales leaders hide behind conditions. The best ones use the cycle to widen the gap on their competitors.
